$comment: Written only by the reconciliation step described in /collaboration/PROTOCOL.md. Never hand-edited to fit a result. conclusions.actual_lineup_check_note: Official lineups confirmed ~1hr pre-kickoff, matching pre-match assumptions with no material change. Draw price unchanged at 3.90; edges recomputed against refreshed Bet365 odds (Coventry 3.80 / Draw 3.90 / Brighton 1.90). Both edges still clear the 3pp threshold -- selection continues to hold.

Official lineups confirmed ~55min pre-kickoff, matching pre-match assumptions with no material change (see collaboration/claude-input.json and collaboration/codex-input.json). BTTS No price unchanged at 2.625; both edges recomputed against the refreshed market -- unchanged (Claude +6.51pp, Codex +5.91pp) -- and still clear the 3pp threshold. Selection continues to hold. NOTE -- this field says 'pending_owner_placement', but ledger/conclusion.json shows this same selection already marked 'placed' (owner-obtained price 2.60, timestamped 2026-09-13T13:01:00Z, over an hour before this lineup check ran). That is a real discrepancy between this file and the ledger, and more importantly means the bet was placed before -- not after -- the confirmed-lineup check required by methodology.md section 6. Flagged for the owner; not resolved here by editing either the status or the ledger's placement record.

conclusions.actual_lineup_check_note: Official confirmed lineups published ~1hr13min pre-kickoff, matching pre-match assumptions with one mild deviation in Newcastle's favour (Dedic started at right-back over Livramento) -- see collaboration/claude-input.json and collaboration/codex-input.json for the full comparison. Away-win price drifted from 3.00 to 2.80 since research time (normal market movement, not team-news driven). Both analysts' edges recomputed against the refreshed market via scripts/edge_calculator.py: Claude's own edge has fallen to +1.29pp, below Claude's 3pp threshold (was +3.37pp) -- Claude's own book and input file now decline this selection (see ledger/claude.json, requests/rejected-selections.json). Codex's edge remains +9.09pp, still clearing comfortably. This means the 'both taken' agreement recorded here at sealed-opening time no longer holds under an independent recheck at today's price -- flagged for the owner, not resolved here by rewriting 'agreement' or 'status' (per PROTOCOL.md, this file is written only by the reconciliation step). Separately, a pre-existing discrepancy also applies here: this entry still reads 'pending_owner_placement', but ledger/conclusion.json shows this exact selection already marked 'placed' (owner-obtained price 2.90, timestamped 2026-09-13T13:01:00Z, more than a day before this lineup check and this edge recompute) -- the same sequencing gap already flagged on the MUN-MCI btts_no entry above. That earlier placement is untouched by today's recompute; it was staked on the original joint analysis, not on today's numbers. Raised to the owner, not resolved here.
